name: omnidownloader-backend
description: Production Node.js backend for OmniDownloader Pro video extraction and streaming API

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('src/assets')) { fs.mkdirSync('dist/assets', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('src/assets', 'dist/assets', { recursive: true }); }"
